definitions.transversal: A line intersecting two or more lines at distinct points.
definitions.alternate interior: Interior angles on opposite sides of a transversal; congruent for parallel lines.
definitions.corresponding angles: Angles at matching positions formed by a transversal.
definitions.slope: Change in vertical position divided by nonzero horizontal change.
definitions.parallel: Distinct coplanar lines that do not meet.
definitions.perpendicular: Lines meeting at a right angle; their nonvertical slopes have product −1.
definitions.coordinate proof: A proof using coordinate facts such as slope, midpoint, and distance.
